EduAI
AI-Powered Learning Platform

Transform Your Study Experience with AI

EduAI helps students and teachers harness the power of AI to create summaries, generate quizzes, and make learning more effective.

Everything You Need to Excel

Powerful AI tools designed for modern education

Document Summaries

Upload your study materials and get AI-generated summaries highlighting key concepts.

Quiz Generation

Automatically create quizzes from your documents with instant AI-powered feedback.

AI Chat Tutor

Ask questions about your documents and get intelligent explanations instantly.

Lesson Plans

Teachers can generate comprehensive lesson plans with objectives and activities.

Slide Generation

Create presentation slides automatically from your lesson plans.

Smart Notes

Take notes linked to your documents and organize your learning journey.

For Students

  • Upload and summarize documents
  • Generate quizzes for practice
  • Get AI explanations for quiz answers
  • Chat with AI about your materials
  • Take organized notes

For Teachers

  • Generate AI lesson plans
  • Create lesson timelines
  • Auto-generate presentation slides
  • Create quizzes from materials
  • All student features included

Ready to Transform Your Learning?

Join thousands of students and teachers using AI to make education more effective.
